title: Manus AI 寻求 5 亿美元融资，在与 Meta 分拆后考虑在香港上市
content:
Manus AI is seeking to raise $500 million and exploring a potential initial public offering in Hong Kong after resuming independent operations following Beijing's order to unwind its acquisition by Meta Platforms, according to The Wall Street Journal.
The funding round would value the company at around $4 billion, according to the Journal, citing unnamed sources. Prospective investors in talks with Manus include investment firms IDG Capital and Boyu Capital, as well as Chinese battery maker Contemporary Amperex Technology. Existing backers Tencent, HSG, and ZhenFund are also considering participating.
The company, which operates primarily out of Singapore, is exploring a restructuring that would lay the groundwork for a Hong Kong listing. Those discussions remain at an early stage, according to the Journal.
Unwinding the Meta transaction required Manus's founders and early backers — including Tencent, HSG, and ZhenFund — to repurchase Meta's shares at a roughly $2 billion valuation, according to the Journal. As a result, Tencent emerged as the company's biggest outside investor.
The broader arc of the deal's collapse began in April, when China's National Development and Reform Commission ordered Meta to unwind its acquisition, prohibiting foreign investment in the company. The directive cited unspecified laws and regulations and offered no further explanation. Meta had announced the acquisition in December 2025, saying it would help advance its AI goals.
China's regulators had raised concerns in part because Manus, though incorporated in Singapore, was founded in China — a structure critics described as an attempt to place the transaction beyond Beijing's regulatory reach. The NDRC's ruling made clear that offshore incorporation does not shield a deal when the underlying technology and talent originated in China. Co-founders Xiao Hong and Ji Yichao were required to appear before Chinese officials in Beijing in March and were subsequently barred from traveling abroad.
Manus announced in August that it would resume operating as an independent company. As part of the separation, data created by users in certain jurisdictions from December 29, 2025 — the day the acquisition closed — was slated for deletion to comply with regulatory requirements.
Manus builds AI agents designed to handle complex tasks, from drafting research reports to producing slide decks. The company is using open-weight models and post-training techniques to improve its product. Manus did not respond to a request for comment.

report.summary: Manus拟融资5亿美元并考虑香港上市
report.background: Manus成立于中国、后以新加坡公司身份运营，主打AI Agent。Meta曾于2025年12月宣布收购，交易于12月29日完成，但中国国家发改委随后在4月以禁止外商投资为由要求分拆。监管认为其技术人才源自中国，离岸架构不能规避审查，创始人被约谈并限制出境。8月Manus恢复独立运营，如今寻求新融资并探索港股IPO，成为中美AI资本与监管博弈的典型案例。
key_points: Manus正寻求约5亿美元新一轮融资，估值约40亿美元。潜在投资方包括IDG资本、博裕资本、宁德时代，腾讯、HSG和真格基金等老股东也在考虑跟投。
中国国家发改委4月要求Meta分拆收购，理由是禁止外商投资。监管强调，即使Manus注册在新加坡，只要技术和人才源自中国，境外架构也不能规避审查。
为完成分拆，创始人和早期投资方按约20亿美元估值回购Meta所持股份，低于新融资估值。腾讯由此成为Manus最大外部投资者，股权结构显著变化。
Manus正初步讨论重组，为在香港上市铺路，但相关磋商仍处早期。此次融资和IPO若成行，将成为中国背景AI公司转向港股的重要案例。
业务上，Manus开发可处理研究报告、PPT制作等复杂任务的AI Agent，使用开源权重模型和后训练技术；分拆合规还导致部分司法辖区用户数据将被删除。
report.impact: 对AI行业而言，此案显示中美资本与技术脱钩风险加剧，中国监管对‘新加坡壳’的穿透审查将影响跨境并购和融资架构。对开发者，AI Agent赛道仍热，但需重视数据合规、出境限制和股权设计；开源模型加后训练仍是低成本创新路径。对普通用户，Manus独立后服务或延续，但部分数据删除、融资与上市不确定性可能影响产品稳定性和隐私安排。
report.tools: 想跟进可关注Manus的Agent产品，以及Qwen、DeepSeek、Llama等开源权重模型；Agent框架如LangChain、AutoGen、CrewAI；后训练与微调工具如LLaMA-Factory、Unsloth、Axolotl。
